info.name: Lynq LLM
info.description: LLM-backed endpoints of the lynq-llm service (FastAPI): job-posting skill extraction, resume parsing, skill extraction, translation, language detection, PDF rendering and candidate assessment. Every route except `/health` requires the `lynq-request-uuid` header (403 without it). `/dmz` routes also require `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`, which lynq-llm resolves against lynq-iam (401 if missing or invalid, 503 if lynq-iam is down); run the Auth folder first to save `accessToken`. `/upskilling_suggestion` and `/candidate-explanation` also require `company-id`. `/internal` routes take `lynq-internal-token` instead of a bearer token. Errors use the `{ success: false, data, reason }` envelope; validation errors return 400.

exec: // Generate a fresh request UUID per call so log tracing stays unique.

request.description: Authenticates against lynq-iam with username + password and saves the returned access token into `accessToken`, which every `/dmz` request sends as a bearer token. Returns 200; 401 on bad credentials.

Liveness/readiness probe reporting service, LLM and PDF renderer status. Needs no headers and is not wrapped in the standard envelope; returns 200 when the configured LLM is reachable and 503 otherwise.

Calls the LLM to extract 5-15 key skills plus generalized similarity tags from a job posting; `company-id` is optional here. Can take long. Returns 200; 400 on an invalid `work_type` (REMOTE or IN_OFFICE), 502 if the LLM fails or returns malformed output.

Downloads a PDF/DOCX resume from a presigned URL, extracts its text and calls the LLM to structure it into the `Resume` JSON. Can take long. Returns 200; 400 for an unsupported document format, 502 if the download or the LLM fails.

Calls the LLM to consolidate a structured resume's skills into technical/tools/soft buckets plus English similarity tags; the optional `language` query param sets the language of the soft skills (English when omitted). Can take long. Returns 200; 502 if the LLM fails.

Calls the LLM to translate every value of a structured resume into `language` (EN, ES, FR or PR). Can take long. Returns 200 with the translated `Resume`; 400 on an unknown language, 502 if the LLM fails.
Calls the LLM to detect the main language of a text, returned as one of EN, ES, FR or PR so it can feed `/translate`. Returns 200; 502 if the LLM fails or answers with an unsupported value.

Renders a structured resume into a styled PDF (template MODERN or CLASSIC, photo optional) and uploads it to the presigned PUT URL; no LLM call. Returns 201 with an empty envelope; 500 if rendering fails, 502 if the upload fails (expected with these placeholder URLs).

Calls the LLM to compare a candidate with a job and resolves each skill gap to Udemy courses; prose is written in the optional `output-language` (English by default) and `company-id` is required. Can take long. Returns 200; 502 if the LLM or the course search fails.

Calls the LLM with the same job/candidate payload to return a hire, no_hire or maybe recommendation with strengths and concerns; `company-id` is required. Can take long. Returns 200; 502 if the LLM fails or returns malformed output.

Same LLM skill extraction as the DMZ route, for service callers without a user token: authenticated by `lynq-internal-token` (set `internalToken` to the local `LYNQ_INTERNAL_TOKEN`); `user-id` and `company-id` are optional log context. Can take long. Returns 200; 401 on a missing or wrong internal token, 502 if the LLM fails.

FastAPI's generated OpenAPI document, served at the root rather than under `/lynq-llm`. Returns 200; 403 without `lynq-request-uuid`, since the request-UUID middleware only exempts `/lynq-llm/health`.
FastAPI's Swagger UI HTML page, served at the root. Returns 200; a browser cannot load it because neither the page nor the `/openapi.json` it fetches carries `lynq-request-uuid` (403).
FastAPI's ReDoc HTML page, served at the root. Returns 200; like Swagger UI it fails in a browser because `/openapi.json` requires `lynq-request-uuid` (403).
